player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Iceman''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Chamber Testing]] list on DeckTech in April 2001.

starting.card: Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration

description: This deck will lay the smack down on anything that has a character at a non-shielded , non-Dagobah site. Check it out if for nothing else the mind expanding Strategy.

notes: Starting cards as posted under Start (9): Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration (posted 'CCT / My Favorite Décor'), Jabba's Prize (posted 'Ice Cube Han'), Cloud City: Security Tower, Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber, Carbonite Chamber Console, Prepared Defenses, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Secret Plans and Ability, Ability, Ability; these count toward the 60. Three Effects start via Prepared Defenses and none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.
Section counts as posted (9+3+24+8+16) match the list; the deck totals 60. No Defensive Shields are posted.
Posted 'Ice Cube Han' dested Jabba's Prize, the frozen-Han captive card that Carbon Chamber Testing starts.
Posted 'Ugnaught x2 OR Jawa x2 OR Abyssin x2  I use the Ugnaughts though' is one either/or line and is printed as written (2 cards); the poster says he plays Ugnaught x2.

Posted 'JP  Achamber', 'Tatooine  DB 94' and 'CC Carbonite Chamber' dested the Dark pages; 'CC East Platform' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'EPP Fett' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Special Edition Jabba' dested Jabba (Special Edition), kept x2 as published although the card is unique.

Posted '4-LOM w/ gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'IG-88 w/ Riot Gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Lirin Carn' Lirin Car'n; 'Hell 2 Pay' There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Scum and Villiany' Scum And Villainy.

Posted 'Oppressive Enforcement / There Is No Try' and 'Hutt Smooch / Defensive Fire' dested the combo cards There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement (an Effect in 2001) and Defensive Fire & Hutt Smooch. Secret Plans is the 2001 Effect (not a Defensive Shield).
Credited to the existing page Mike Fitzgerald, which already cites his DeckTech report as 'Iceman'.
The strategy ends with the lyrics of Twisted Sister's 'I Wanna Rock'; they are part of the posted text.
